about_the_game:
🥊 Get ready to punch fruit like a pro in the wildest boxing game ever! 🍉

Dodge, duck, and deliver knockout blows to flying pumpkins and watermelons hurled by zany wizards and chaotic drones. These aren’t your average fruits—they punch back with jabs, hooks, and sneaky uppercuts! 🥊

💥 Watch out for explosive pumpkins and watermelons—hit one, and you’ll take a score penalty! Stay sharp or pay the price.

💪 Don’t just tap—use real strength! Weak hits won’t count, so bring the power punch!

🍉 Challenge Yourself and Practice Your Boxing Skill in This High-Speed Fruit-Punching Frenzy! 🥊

Strap on your headset and enter the ultimate fruity showdown—where flying pumpkins and rogue watermelons come at you fast, launched by sneaky fruit wizards and relentless aerial attack drones! Dodge, slice, and try not to get splattered!

Each piece of fruit punches like a pro—throwing:

🥊 Straight jabs

🔁 Left hooks

🔄 Right hooks

🕳️ The dreaded shovel hook

The more you smash, the wilder it gets!

As the action turns completely bananas, only the quickest reflexes can keep up with the rhythm… like the legendary Thousand-Hand Guanyin on a fruit-fueled rampage.

🍌 Can you keep up?

To gear up:

Just walk to the boxing gloves or use the left hand controller’s thumbstick to move the gloves to you.

Hold the left-controller’s grip button to equip your left glove.

Hold the right-controller’s grip button to equip your right glove.

Need help or access settings?  Press the X button on your left-controller to bring help-menu up at any time.

The longer you play, the faster and wilder the attacks become.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or greater
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR Oculus Touch / Index / Rift / Vive Controller

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
